sentences.text: These two get mixed up all the time, so let’s separate them.
Not under command is about cause: some exceptional circumstance, like a failed engine or a jammed rudder, means the vessel can’t maneuver as the rules require.
So the word to remember is broken.
Restricted in her ability to maneuver is about work: the job she’s doing keeps her from getting out of the way.
Dredging, laying cable, servicing a buoy, diving operations, surveying, or a tow that pins her to her course.
Ask yourself: is she broken, or is she busy?
